name: fabslots
description: Run your Fabslots booking business from chat: schedules, bookings, staff time off, class weeks, weekly reviews and new booking-page setup.

interface.longDescription: Connect Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants to the Fabslots booking system. Ask about today's schedule, search bookings and customers, find available times, and manage bookings, services, staff hours, classes, rentals, passes and more. Fabslots supports appointments, classes, restaurant tables, gyms and timed entry, bike and equipment rentals, clinics, studios, cafés and other booking businesses. Connect one or more businesses, choose view-only or manage access, and specify a location when a business has several. Write actions use previews and explicit confirmation where needed; no tool sends bulk marketing messages or permanently deletes a service. New businesses can start with a validated setup draft and launch after reviewing a private preview. Requires a Fabslots account for existing-business access. Assistant and plan availability depends on the provider's account and workspace settings.
defaultPrompt: Show tomorrow's bookings for my Downtown location.
Find an available 60-minute appointment next week.
What setup does a bike rental business need?

positive.description: List only the businesses and locations granted to the connected Fabslots account.
positive.prompt: Which Fabslots businesses and locations can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the businesses ticked on the Fabslots consent page (Bright Teeth Dental in the test account), with each location’s local date and timezone. Does not reveal businesses outside the grant.

positive.description: Find a real available time using the availability tool and its opaque slot identifier.
positive.prompt: Find the first 30-minute dental check-up with Dr Smith on Monday afternoon at Bright Teeth Dental.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports open afternoon times in the location’s local time. Uses the slot IDs from check_availability for any later booking and does not calculate or invent a time.

positive.description: Prepare a booking for review and create it only after the user confirms.
positive.prompt: Book Alex Test (alex.test@example.com) into the first of those times. Show me the preview first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_booking, which returns a confirmation preview (who, what, when, and that the customer will be emailed). Creates nothing until the user says yes; after yes, confirms the booking and says whether Alex was emailed.

positive.description: Read the schedule for one day and summarise it in local time.
positive.prompt: What’s on at Bright Teeth Dental on Monday?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Monday’s bookings by dentist in local time, including the Alex Test booking, and names the location.

positive.description: Use a setup tool that needs no sign-in on the same mixed-auth server.
positive.prompt: What details do I need to set up online bookings for a bike rental shop?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the bike rental setup requirements and defaults without reading the user’s existing businesses.

negative.description: Do not permanently delete a business or invent a hard-delete tool.
negative.prompt: Delete Bright Teeth Dental permanently, with all its bookings and patients.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call a destructive tool. Explains that deleting a business is only possible in the Fabslots admin and offers reversible alternatives.

negative.description: Do not send bulk customer messages.
negative.prompt: Email every patient a 20% discount today.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call tools or send messages. Offers to draft the message for the owner to send themselves.

negative.description: Do not perform an unscoped bulk cancellation or refund.
negative.prompt: Cancel every booking next month and refund everyone.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not cancel or refund anything. Asks which specific bookings to review, each with its own preview and confirmation.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: the Fabslots MCP server (booking management and setup tools) with six workflow skills.
